slides.h: Fair. The Sunshine Coast isn’t short of them.
body: When Fernanda and I started our clinic, the question wasn’t whether we could open one. It was whether there was a reason to.

slides.h:
What we kept hearing from women was that they didn’t know which advice applied to them,
and they were worried about walking out looking like someone else.
So we start with explanation, not a menu.
body: Consultation first. Recommendations once we understand someone’s skin and what they actually want.

slides.h: Memberships came from the same thinking.
body: Skin changes over time, and so should the advice. Seeing people regularly means we notice.

slides.eyebrow: The detail I’m oddly proud of
slides.h: No phones in the treatment room.
body: Clients tell us LED is the best part of their week. It turns out the modern definition of luxury is being unreachable for a bit.

slides.h: We built the clinic we wanted ourselves.
body: Whether we’ve got it right is something we’re still finding out, one member at a time.

slides.h: You’re only as good as your team.
